locale.description: Saves each sheet in the current Calc document as a separate HTML file in the same directory as the original Calc document. (This ooRexx sample is modelled after the JavaScript sample that gets distributed with OOo.)
Adds the the string "Hello World" into the current text doc. (This ooRexx sample is modelled after the JavaScript sample that gets distributed with OOo.)
ooRexx sample to demonstrate how to use the OOo dispatch framework to create on-the-fly documentation for an OOo UNO object and an UNO IDL string using the ooRexx utility macro 'UNO_API_info.rxo'.
Updates a spreadsheet with the current memory usage statistics for the Java Virtual Machine (This ooRexx sample is modelled after the BeanShell sample that gets distributed with OOo.)
